key_insight: Pairwise Bellman validation selects off-policy evaluation models using candidate differences as critics, avoiding auxiliary validation models and separate critic optimization.
engineering_relevance: PBV simplifies selection of fitted Q-functions and occupancy-ratio estimators using held-out transitions and finite empirical moment calculations.
method: Construct pairwise critics from Q-function differences or log ratios of occupancy-ratio candidates.
Select candidates with penalized minimax Bellman or adjoint Bellman moment scores.
Use unweighted PBV, target-aligned PBV, or adjoint PBV for the corresponding estimation task.
evidence_signal: The paper establishes finite-sample oracle inequalities under candidate misspecification and reports competitive unweighted PBV performance on Hopper and Deep OPE, with weighting benefits under controlled overlap.
watch_item: Unweighted PBV guarantees require pairwise coercivity, while target-aligned PBV relies on marginalized importance weighting whose practical reliability depends on overlap and weight quality.
paper_title: Model Selection for Off-Policy Evaluation via Pairwise Bellman Validation
